# Neo Impex Stainless Pvt. Ltd.

> Manufacturer and exporter of ASME buttweld pipe fittings (seamless to 24 inch, welded to 72 inch) and forged flanges (1/2 inch to 60 inch, Class 150 to 2500) from Vadodara, India. Established 2005. Supplies distributors, fabricators and contractors in the USA and Canada with EN 10204 3.1 certificates.

Contact: kartik@neoimpexglobal.com, WhatsApp +91 93166 31458. Quote reply within 24 business hours.
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/neo-impex-stainless-pvt-ltd/

## Products
- [Buttweld Fittings Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/): ASME B16.9 buttweld fittings: elbows, tees, reducers, caps, stub ends, crosses and bends. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Forged Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/): ASME B16.5 and B16.47 forged flanges: weld neck, slip-on, blind, socket weld, threaded, lap joint, RTJ. ½″ to 60″, Class 150–2500. Export to USA, Canada.
- [Buttweld Elbows Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/elbows/): ASME B16.9 buttweld elbows in 45°, 90° and 180°, long and short radius. Stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy, nickel. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″.
- [Buttweld Tees Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/tees/): ASME B16.9 equal and reducing buttweld tees in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Buttweld Reducers Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/reducers/): Concentric and eccentric ASME B16.9 buttweld reducers in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy, nickel. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″. Export to USA, Canada.
- [Buttweld End Caps Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/caps/): ASME B16.9 buttweld pipe end caps in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Stub Ends Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/stub-ends/): Long and short pattern buttweld stub ends to ASME B16.9 and MSS SP-43 in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Buttweld Crosses Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/crosses/): ASME B16.9 straight and reducing buttweld crosses in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy, nickel. Seamless to 24″, welded to 72″. Export to USA and Canada.
- [180° Return Bends Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/return-bends/): ASME B16.9 and B16.28 180° long and short radius return bends in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Pipe Bends 3D 5D 10D & Piggable Bends | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/buttweld-fittings/pipe-bends/): 3D, 5D and 10D pipe bends, induction bends and piggable bends to R = 22D, up to 24″. Made in our own bending shop. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Weld Neck Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/weld-neck/): ASME B16.5 and B16.47 weld neck flanges, raised face and RTJ, ½″ to 60″, Class 150 to 2500. Stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy, nickel. Export to USA/Canada.
- [Slip-On Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/slip-on/): ASME B16.5 slip-on raised face flanges, ½″ to 24″, in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Forged in India. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Blind Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/blind/): ASME B16.5 and B16.47 blind flanges, ½″ to 60″, Class 150 to 2500. Stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Socket Weld Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/socket-weld/): ASME B16.5 socket weld raised face flanges for small-bore, high-pressure lines in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Threaded Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/threaded/): ASME B16.5 threaded (NPT screwed) flanges in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Forged in India, exported to the USA and Canada.
- [Lap Joint Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/lap-joint/): ASME B16.5 lap joint flanges for use with stub ends, in stainless, duplex, carbon, alloy and nickel alloys. Forged in India. Export to USA and Canada.
- [RTJ Flanges Manufacturer & Exporter | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/ring-type-joint/): Ring type joint (RTJ) flanges to ASME B16.5 for high-pressure oil and gas, Class 600 to 2500. Weld neck and blind RTJ flanges. Export to USA and Canada.
- [Long Weld Neck Flanges Manufacturer | USA, Canada](https://neoimpexglobal.com/flanges/long-weld-neck/): Long weld neck (LWN) flanges with extended hubs for pressure vessel and column nozzles, made to your drawing. Export to USA and Canada.
